info.description: Community-maintained coverage of the documented OpenF1 v1 endpoints. The provider makes historical data from 2023 onward available without authentication; real-time access requires a paid subscription. Response record fields vary by endpoint and are left open. The API can filter by scalar record attributes, but this specification lists common selectors and documented examples rather than every endpoint-specific filter.
info.title: OpenF1 API
